main_measure.name: mean next-day unusual move in the short direction on forecast<0 bars

statistic.name: t of the mean, cases summed per day

main_measure.threshold: confirm: mean > 0 with t >= 2 over >= 100 distinct days and upper half beats lower half; reject: mean < 0 with t <= -2 over >= 100 distinct days

supporting_check.name: mean unusual move, upper minus lower half of abs(forecast)

decided_by: Mean unusual move above 0 with t >= 2 over at least 100 distinct days, and the upper half of abs(forecast) beats the lower half.
reading: Situation computed from prices as 1-day return > 0 and high-low range above its 20-bar mean (bar t included), falling back to regime=='trending' on the first bars of a window where it cannot be computed, side short (forecast < 0); coin mean daily return is the mean of all within-window next-day returns over all its windows; t clusters cases by UTC date; the median split puts abs(forecast) > median in the upper half and <= median in the lower half.

direction_check.why: main measure +0.006848 on the check folds against +0.008181 on every fold
